entities.summary: Nador is a coastal city and provincial capital in the northeastern Rif region of Morocco with a population of about 158,202 . It is the capital of the homonymous Nador Province with more than 600,000 inhabitants. Nador is considered the second largest city in the Oriental Region after Oujda.
